title: Grateful Dead Live at Ivar Theater on 1966-02-25

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear early‑1966 recording captures a high‑energy set with standout blues/rock medleys like Good Morning Little School Girl > You Don’t Love Me and a superb Stealin’ performance.
ai_review.review: The audience‑sourced tape is praised for its remarkable clarity and balanced mix, making listeners feel right in the room. Musically the show erupts with fiery playing—Jerry’s licks, Pigpen’s soaring harp, and early renditions of King Bee, I Know You Rider and a second‑take Stealin’ that many fans flag as a highlight.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly 5‑star praise for both performance and sound quality, with only one low outlier; the consensus indicates an exceptional early show captured in excellent condition.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the mix crystal‑clear, well‑balanced and “perfect,” with no mention of hiss, dropouts or other flaws.

standout_songs: Good Morning Little School Girl > You Don't Love Me (medley)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑60s blues/rock set flows smoothly through medleys; the transition from Good Morning Little School Girl into You Don't Love Me and back is highlighted, and the second Stealin' feels like a perfect closing statement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note his “lick I love” and future‑Jer style playing; guitar work described as fiery and expressive.
